title: Representing Clinical Conditions on Vital Signs from Healthy Individuals using Latent Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.15379v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning can be crucial to help scale complex signal processing applications in scenarios such as healthcare. However, these machine learning models need rich datasets to be trained and there are often cases where it is not possible to access representative datasets. In this paper, we propose a deep generative model based on conditional variational autoencoders with the objective of augmenting the vital signs of healthy individuals in a way that mimics the patterns of a certain clinical condition. More specifically, we use a publicly available ICU (Intensive Care Unit) dataset to train our model and then evaluate it using the vital data that we have collected from healthy individuals. translated_title: 使用潜在建模在健康个体生命体征上表征临床病症
translated_abstract: 机器学习对于在医疗保健等场景中扩展复杂信号处理应用至关重要。然而，这些机器学习模型需要丰富的数据集进行训练，而通常情况下无法获取具有代表性的数据集。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器的深度生成模型，其目标是以模拟某种临床病症模式的方式对健康个体的生命体征进行数据增强。更具体地说，我们使用公开可用的ICU（重症监护室）数据集来训练我们的模型，然后使用我们从健康个体收集的生命体征数据对其进行评估。我们的结果表明，所提出的模型不仅能够学习ICU数据的内在动态特性，更重要的是，能够以与某种临床病症的生命体征相一致的方式重塑我们从健康个体收集的数据。
tldr: 提出一种基于条件变分自编码器的深度生成模型，能够将健康个体的生命体征数据转换为模拟特定临床病症模式的体征数据，从而解决医疗领域代表性训练数据难以获取的问题。
en_tdlr: A deep generative model based on conditional variational autoencoders that transforms vital signs of healthy individuals to mimic patterns of specific clinical conditions, addressing the scarcity of representative medical training datasets.
